create_VideomtConfig: create a VideomtConfig instance with default transformer and segmentation parameters
build_VideomtConfig_custom: build a VideomtConfig with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads values
configure_Videomt_segmentation: configure VideomtConfig for universal segmentation with num_queries, mask_weight, and dice_weight
initialize_Videomt_model: initialize a VideomtForUniversalSegmentation model from a VideomtConfig instance
access_Videomt_config: access the config attribute from an initialized VideomtForUniversalSegmentation model
